title: Happy Easter!
excerpt: Easter greetings from the ATTP leadership
body_html:
These moments reconcile and unite all of humanity in celebrating together the Resurrection of the Lord.

In these special days, we wish everyone more kindness, light and peace, and may the holy feast of Easter bring warmth and joy to every heart!

Dear friends!

We also sincerely wish that your thoughts and actions be only for the good and that you always be surrounded by people of good faith with light in their souls! May God grant each of you love and a strong faith. So, friends, be happy in every moment and rejoice in every day of your life. Welcome into your hearts the Light of the Resurrection and the full joy of this Feast!

Good health to you and your loved ones!

Happy holidays!
